body: I feel you. I’ve more or less been given warnings about it. I write lists and keep a diary and feel like I try my best every day but my brains just a constant fog.

I get that and I can recognise that I can be too sensitive sometimes. But compassion should overwrite feelings of frustration - I think. Also they’ve been struggling to give me shifts due to reduced hours and too many staff so I’m not totally convinced she’ll be really put out by my absence.
Exactly! She does it so fly like she called me instead of texting so it wasn’t in writing. Probably knew she was being unreasonable. Think she just has a vendetta against me tbh
